## `/fundadmin:fund audit-support <file>` {#audit-support}

Draft management rep letter, confirmation list & schedules

Drafts an audit support pack: representation letter draft, confirmation population for the auditor, and helper-backed capital and fee schedules. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund audit-support`, asks to prepare for the annual audit, or shares capital account data.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund audit-support <file>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-audit-support <file>` |
| Codex | `$fund-audit-support <file>` |

**Writes** `AUDIT-SUPPORT-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-audit-support/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund waterfall-review <file>` {#waterfall-review}

Waterfall/fee term review & consistency checks

Extracts waterfall tiers, preferred return, catch-up, carry, clawback and fee terms, checks consistency and records comparisons only against identified, dated sources. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund waterfall-review`, asks about fund economics, or shares waterfall provisions.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund waterfall-review <file>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-waterfall-review <file>` |
| Codex | `$fund-waterfall-review <file>` |

**Writes** `WATERFALL-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-waterfall-review/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund report-pdf` {#report-pdf}

PDF of validated report, tables, findings and limitations

Renders fund review Markdown or structured JSON into a formatted PDF, preserving report content, score labels and scales, evidence and limitations. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund report-pdf` or asks for a PDF of a review.
